text: - A node is a stacking-context root for opacity not equal to 1, fixed or sticky position, z-index on relative or absolute (or static flex/grid items), any transform/rotate/scale/translate, atomic paint effects, or `isolation: isolate` (packages/blitz-dom/src/node/node.rs:1343-1388); atomic paint effects are opacity, filter, clip-path and mask-image (packages/blitz-dom/src/node/node.rs:1390-1419)

subject: depth
text: - Children paint in stacking order: negative z-index hoisted children, regular paint children, then positive z-index hoisted children (packages/blitz-paint/src/render.rs:1148-1211); hit-testing walks positive-z hoisted children, then paint children in reverse, then negative-z hoisted children (packages/blitz-dom/src/node/node.rs:1587-1651), skipping a node dropped since the last resolve as the paint tree's walk does (architecture §Standard Contracts → Scrolling, selection, tree), and since 2026-10-10-scrolling-box-bounds-and-hit it stops at the padding box of a node paint clips — by `overflow`, or by a computed `contain` that includes `paint` on a box paint applies it to (ratified by the founder, 2026-10-18) — the root element excepted: a point outside that box reaches none of the node's hoisted children, paint children or inline content, as paint clips them, and the node itself is still answered inside its border box (packages/blitz-dom/src/node/node.rs:1553-1586; as measured at escher-0.1.0/chunks/2026-10-10-scrolling-box-bounds-and-hit/report.md); this walk is the page's: a row of an open select list stands outside it, answered before the walk by `select_list_hit` in `hit_with_scrollbar`, so a box clipping the select clips no row (packages/blitz-dom/src/document.rs:2436-2438; tests/blitz-tests/tests/select_popup.rs:673-712; as measured at escher-0.3.0/chunks/2026-10-31-select-popup/report.md); since 2026-10-14-stand-requirement-sweep its answer at an element's own box is measured, in both layout modes and both builds — an `img` holding raster data answers the `img`, a block inside an `iframe`'s `srcdoc` sub-document answers the `iframe` (the parent's walk does not enter the sub-document, pinned as it reads) and a filled text `input` answers the `input` — and a box both transformed and scrolled is hit where its rows show, not through its scrolled-out content (tests/blitz-tests/tests/hit_clipped_at_scrolling_box.rs:431-584; as measured at escher-0.1.0/chunks/2026-10-14-stand-requirement-sweep/report.md)
